content.value_statement: Creating a new Unite-Hub agent requires coordinated code, routing, registry, tests, and governance steps. This skill gives a concise checklist and templates for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Shows where to create a TypeScript agent file that extends BaseAgent.
Provides an Anthropic message creation example using task payload data.
Explains how to add a new intent path to the orchestrator router.
Lists registry fields for queue name, governance, budget, model, and category.
Includes a Vitest test outline and an optional CLI runner example.
limitations: It is a documentation template, not a generator that writes files automatically.
Examples use placeholder names and must be adapted to project conventions.
It does not cover deployment, monitoring, or production incident response.
It does not implement validation, authorization, or tenant isolation for a real agent.

use_cases.title: Add a Product Agent
use_cases.description: Plan the files, router changes, registry entry, and tests needed for a new Unite-Hub agent.

use_cases.title: Review Agent Governance
use_cases.description: Check that a proposed agent includes budget limits, verification requirements, and the correct governance mode.

use_cases.title: Prepare Agent Tests
use_cases.description: Use the testing outline to create a focused validation path before connecting an agent to production queues.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Agent
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new Unite-Hub agent.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the new-agent-creation skill to outline the files and decisions needed for a new Unite-Hub agent named [agent name]. Include the agent purpose, queue name, registry fields, and test scope.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt the Agent Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn a concept into implementation steps.
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the new-agent-creation guidance, adapt the agent template for [task type]. Show the class responsibilities, payload fields, model choice, and expected result fields in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Route and Register the Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add routing and registry coverage for [agent name]. Identify the intent keyword, router update, registry metadata, queue name, governance mode, verification rule, and daily budget.

prompt_templates.title: Review Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned Unite-Hub agent against the new-agent-creation checklist. Focus on workspace isolation, budget limits, test coverage, verification gates, governance mode, and documentation gaps.

output_examples.input: Create a plan for a new email triage agent.
output: Agent file path and class responsibilities are identified.
Router intent, registry metadata, queue name, and governance choice are listed.
Testing and verification tasks are grouped before release.

output_examples.input: Review whether my new agent is ready to register.
output: The review flags missing budget limits and incomplete workspace checks.
It recommends adding verification requirements before enabling the agent.
It separates required fixes from optional documentation updates.

best_practices: Define the agent purpose, queue name, payload shape, and governance mode before writing implementation code.
Add tests for successful processing, invalid payloads, retries, and workspace isolation.
Set budget limits and verification requirements before registering the agent for shared use.
anti_patterns: Do not register an agent before its router path and tests are complete.
Do not process task payloads without validating required fields and workspace ownership.
Do not use autonomous governance for high-impact actions without an approval path.

faq.question: Does this skill create files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides templates and a checklist that users apply inside their own repository.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What kind of agents does it describe?
faq.answer: It describes Unite-Hub agents that extend BaseAgent, process queued tasks, and call an Anthropic model.

faq.question: Does it include testing guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a Vitest-style test outline for task processing and result checks.

faq.question: Does it cover governance?
faq.answer: Yes. It reminds users to choose a governance mode, set budget limits, and require verification.

faq.question: What should users customize first?
faq.answer: Users should replace placeholder names, define capabilities, choose a queue name, and validate the task payload shape.
